The AI layer is a 2,373,700-parameter multi-label neural network (v2 architecture: 2,560 hashed bag-of-tokens + 48 engineered features → 768 → 384 → 192 → 4 outputs) trained offline by distilling expert security heuristics into the network, then int8-quantized and embedded in this page. Inference runs 100% locally — no data leaves your browser. It complements, and does not replace, the rule-based findings.
◆ What's new in v2
  • AI risk engine upgraded — 2,373,700 parameters (up from 1.5M): 2608 → 768 → 384 → 192 → 4, retrained and re-verified (all heads AUC 1.00, quantized accuracy ≥ 99.7%).
  • 8 new checks — Subresource Integrity on external scripts, unsandboxed iframes, javascript: links, duplicate IDs, image layout shift (CLS), unlabeled form inputs, meta-refresh redirects, inline-handler audit.
  • Scan history — your recent scans and scores are stored in this browser only (localStorage) for one-click rescans.

⚠ Use this tool only on websites you own or have explicit permission to test. This is a passive, browser-side scanner — it fetches publicly reachable pages only and cannot replace a full penetration test.
